# DEWALT® Unveils the World’s First Downward Drilling, Fleet-Capable Robot to Accelerate Data Center Construction  
### 20 January 2026  
- *Amidst a rapid expansion of more than 400 data centers in development around the world*1, DEWALT, in collaboration with August Robotics, is pushing the boundaries of innovation to address evolving customer needs
- *Robotic drilling solution has cut 80 weeks off data center construction timelines for one of the world’s largest technology companies as global demand for AI computing power skyrockets*
- *Powered by August Robotics’ autonomous drilling and fleet orchestration platform, the robot achieved 99.97% drilling accuracy across 90,000+ holes throughout ongoing pilot program with a leading hyperscaler*  
**TOWSON, Md. January 20, 2026** – DEWALT, a Stanley Black & Decker (NYSE: SWK) brand and relentless innovator for job site professionals, today announced in collaboration with leading international mobile robotics company August Robotics, the launch of the world’s first downward drilling, fleet-capable robot to enable fast, safe, and efficient concrete drilling to accelerate data center construction.  
As the race to meet global AI processing needs intensifies, the robot is currently being piloted and has completed 10 phases of data center construction with one of the world’s largest and most influential tech companies, or “hyperscalers,” helping to significantly boost construction output.
The addition of the robot strengthens DEWALT’s data center ecosystem encompassing PERFORM AND PROTECT™ tools and technology that mitigate vibration and dust and enhance user control, as well as DEWALT’s industry-leading ICC anchoring solutions.  
The robotic drilling solution is expected to be available commercially mid-year2026 and will be demoed at the World of Concrete® Trade Show in Las Vegas from January20-22.  
To learn more about groundbreaking DEWALT innovation and industry-leading total solutions for job site professionals, visit [www.DEWALT.com](https://www.dewalt.com).  
To learn more about August Robotics and its autonomous mobile robotics solutions for construction, visit [www.augustrobotics.com](https://www.augustrobotics.com).

results.name: Robosen Unveils $1,400 Optimus Prime Anniversary Robot — giznewsdaily
results.content:
Robosen has unveiled a limited-edition addition to its Transformers flagship series, the Fallen Leader Optimus Prime G1. The new release commemorates a pivotal moment from the 1986 animated film *The Transformers: The Movie* and breaks from the character’s traditional palette with a battle-damaged aesthetic.
## Movement, Voice, and App Control  
The robot retains the series’ hallmark auto-conversion capability, shifting between robot and vehicle mode with 50 built-in microchips and 27 servo motors driving its transformations and poses. Owners can issue more than 50 voice commands—including “convert” and “attack”—while a companion mobile app enables new action downloads, hidden feature unlocks, and software updates. For custom choreography, Robosen Studio PC software allows users to design their own battle sequences. The figure can also perform synchronized motion and dialogue alongside the existing Flagship Megatron and Flagship Bumblebee units, recreating classic confrontations. Compatibility does not extend to the Elite Optimus Prime Trailer Kit, which is supported separately.
## Limited Pre-Order Window  
Priced at $1,399, the Fallen Leader Optimus Prime G1 is currently available for pre-order at a $400 discount. North American availability is capped at 1,000 units, with the pre-order period closing on August 25, 2026, at 11:59 PM EDT. Shipping is scheduled to begin in December 2026, and each pre-order includes a complimentary Robosen coaster.
